title: NBA-to-POL Technique Port: ET-200f Attractor + LR Scale-Up (fire-129 ODD Rotation C)

evidence.nba_et_attractor: 5/5 NBA islands (S13/S14/S15/S18/S22) show ET-200f in pareto front across multiple fires. This is the strongest cross-island signal in 129 fires.
evidence.nba_lr_confirmed: S14 gen=684 logistic_regression-48f in pareto (vm-add-logistic-regression fire-110 working). LR is the academically confirmed best model for NBA (Brier=0.199, 12th confirm across papers).
evidence.pol_lr_confirmed: P7 logistic_regression-102f appears in pareto fire-129 (1st POL LR detection). Cross-validates NBA finding.
evidence.s22_extraordinary: S22 brier=0.22124 at gen=60 (cycle 20) — only 0.00112 from fleet best. RF-200f-0.22161 in pareto. Fastest convergence seen in 129 fires.

proposals.title: Add extra_trees to all POL island model pools
proposals.rationale: ET-200f dominates 5/5 NBA pareto fronts. POL uses xgboost_brier exclusively in current best model. ET may outperform on POL categorical-heavy political data (similar feature sparsity pattern).
proposals.action: Edit POL island init/mutate to include extra_trees alongside xgboost_brier/lightgbm in model pool

proposals.title: Scale LR+ElasticNet to all 5 POL islands
proposals.rationale: P7 shows LR-102f in pareto (first POL LR detection). NBA confirms LR=0.199 as best Brier. Scaling from P7 to all 5 POL islands should unlock similar improvement.
proposals.action: Add logistic_regression + elastic_net to P1/P2/P4/P5 model pools (P7 already has it)

proposals.title: Test rolling P1 restart to probe early convergence rate
proposals.rationale: S22 hits 0.22124 at gen=60 from fresh start. P1 (cycle=1103) stagnating near 0.249. NBA triple-attractor pattern (S14/S18/S22) shows fresh starts often hit better early attractors. P1 = oldest POL island.
proposals.action: Deliberate factory restart of P1. Monitor first 100 gens. If brier < 0.247 by gen=100, the fresh-start attractor hypothesis is confirmed for POL.
proposals.risk: P1 may lose pareto history. Run on lowest-performer island first.

cross_fleet_insights.convergent_signal: LightGBM-0.249 appears in P2/P4/P5/P7 pareto simultaneously (4/5 POL islands). Strongest POL signal since fire-109.
cross_fleet_insights.nba_analogy: NBA ET-200f attractor (5/5) → POL LightGBM-0.249 attractor (4/5). Both suggest a dominant model type per domain.
cross_fleet_insights.action: Port: ensure all 5 POL islands have lightgbm + lightgbm_brier + extra_trees + logistic_regression in their model pool (currently xgboost_brier only or sparse mix).
